members.name: New England Regional Art Museum
members.bio: Regional art museum with six gallery spaces, holding the Hinton, Chandler Coventry and NERAM collections.
members.photo_file: E. New England Regional Art Museum (NERAM).jpg

members.name: Saumarez Homestead
members.bio: National Trust homestead of 30 furnished rooms built 1888 to 1906, with gardens and guided house tours.
members.hours: Gardens 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM Wed, Fri–Sun; house by guided tour only

members.name: Uralla
members.bio: Heritage town on the New England Highway with a Captain Thunderbolt statue and McCrossin's Mill museum.

members.name: The Big Lamb
members.bio: 1988 Poll Dorset sheep sculpture marking Guyra's lamb and potato industries beside the highway.

members.name: Point Lookout
members.bio: A 1,564 m escarpment lookout with views across World Heritage rainforest to the distant ocean.
members.photo_file: Point Lookout, New England National Park.jpg

members.name: Ebor Falls
members.bio: Tiered waterfall on the Guy Fawkes River with an easy 2 km return walk linking six lookouts.

members.name: Cathedral Rock National Park
members.bio: Granite park with a 6 km loop walk to a summit of stacked boulders and wide tableland views.
members.hours: Open 24 hours (may close for poor weather or fire danger)
members.photo_file: Granite outcrops (Tors). View from Cathedral Rock (49193129052).jpg

members.name: Cunnawarra National Park
members.bio: Remote park with the tallest eucalypts in NSW, Beech Lookout over World Heritage rainforest and 4WD tracks.
members.hours: Open 24 hours (may close for poor weather or fire danger)

members.name: Wollomombi Falls
members.bio: One of the highest waterfalls in New South Wales, viewed from lookouts above Inaccessible Gulf.

members.name: Apsley Falls
members.bio: Two Apsley River waterfalls, the first dropping about 65 m, seen from lookouts on a 1.2 km rim walk.

members.name: Tamworth Golden Guitar
members.bio: A 12 m golden guitar from 1988 at Tamworth's southern entrance, floodlit at night beside the visitor centre.
members.hours: Guitar open 24 hours; visitor centre 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM daily
members.photo_file: Big Golden Guitar during a nice day, October 2025.jpg

members.name: Australian Country Music Hall of Fame
members.bio: Peel Street museum of country music with stage outfits, instruments and the Walk a Country Mile exhibition.
members.photo_file: external:Australian Country Music Hall of Fame

members.name: Australian Standing Stones
members.bio: Celtic tribute monument in Centennial Parklands, a stone calendar of the seasons begun in 1991.

members.name: Kings Plains National Park
members.bio: Small park with a creekside 3 km return walk to Kings Plains Falls, which flow only after rain.
members.hours: Open 24 hours (may close for poor weather or fire danger)

members.name: Sir Henry Parkes School of Arts
members.bio: 1876 School of Arts where Sir Henry Parkes gave his 1889 Federation oration, now a museum and theatre.

members.name: Bald Rock National Park
members.bio: Australia's largest granite monolith, a 260 m dome with walking tracks onto the rock.
members.hours: Open 24 hours (may close for poor weather or fire danger)

members.name: Boonoo Boonoo National Park
members.bio: Park centred on Boonoo Boonoo Falls, with rock pools, short lookout walks and swimming spots.
members.hours: Open 24 hours (may close for poor weather or fire danger)

members.name: Copeton Dam
members.bio: Lake Copeton behind a rockfill dam on the Gwydir River, with fishing, boating and camping at Copeton Waters.
members.hours: Park access 5:00 AM – 9:30 PM (office 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM)

members.name: Myall Creek Massacre Memorial Site
members.bio: Memorial walk of seven granite boulders at the 1838 Myall Creek massacre site, near Bingara.

members.name: Sawn Rocks
members.bio: Organ-pipe rock cliff at the end of an easy 1.5 km return walk beside a shady creek bed.
members.photo_file: Mount Kaputar National Park, Narrabri, NSW. Sawn-rocks 01.jpg

members.name: Narrabri
members.bio: Namoi River town and base for Mount Kaputar, the Paul Wild Observatory and the Pilliga forest.

members.name: Horton Falls National Park
members.bio: Waterfall and rock pools in the Nandewar foothills, with a rustic campground, 40 minutes from Barraba.
members.hours: Open 24 hours (may close for poor weather or fire danger)

members.name: Cape Byron Lighthouse
members.bio: Lighthouse on mainland Australia's easternmost point, where whales, dolphins and turtles are often seen.
members.hours: Lawn 8:00 AM – sunset; museum 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM

members.name: Main Beach
members.bio: Byron's town beach, patrolled all summer, with waves that usually break close to shore.
members.photo_file: Main Beach and Cape Byron, Byron Bay, New South Wales, Australia (Ank Kumar, Infosys Limited) 02.jpg

members.name: Wategos Beach
members.bio: Beach on the north side of the cape, a longboarder favourite because its waves generally lack push.

members.name: The Pass
members.bio: Surf break at the south end of Main Beach, with wide rolling waves for longboarders and crowds in summer.

members.name: Julian Rocks
members.bio: Islets 2.5 km off Cape Byron where temperate and tropical waters meet, reached by dive or snorkel boat.
members.hours: Daily snorkel and dive trips by boat; book ahead

members.name: Tallow Beach
members.bio: Very long beach south of the Byron headland, where swells run straight in and surf is generally larger.
members.photo_file: Broken Head From Tallow Beach October 2008.jpg

members.name: Crystal Castle and Shambhala Gardens
members.bio: Hinterland gardens with some of the world's largest geodes and the southern hemisphere's only Kalachakra stupa.

members.name: Brunswick Heads
members.bio: Seaside village at the Brunswick River mouth, with Torakina Beach inside the breakwater and timber bridges.

members.name: Bangalow
members.bio: Hinterland village whose single main street is lined with Federation-style buildings, cafes and restaurants.

members.name: Mullumbimby
members.bio: Brunswick Valley town below Mount Chincogan, billing itself 'The Biggest Little Town in Australia'.
